notes: This is a refutation of a name that appears on almost every student-offer list beside AWS Educate. The two AWS programmes are different in kind: AWS Educate is open to any individual with an email but its labs are simulated, and AWS Academy needs an institution and an educator but its students still receive no compute. Neither is a compute source. What would overturn this is a lab or credit line on the AWS Academy student page; the page was read in full at 1758 words and states none.
